room.subtitle: Your private retreat
room.title: The Room
room.description: Furnished with authentic pieces from rural tradition and refined finishes, our room offers sophisticated comfort without betraying the original spirit of the "grandmother's house". An intimate and quiet environment, designed to provide deep and restorative rest, far from the hectic daily pace.

house.subtitle: Shared spaces, timeless stories
house.title: The House
house.description: The property preserves the charm of ancient Piedmontese farmhouses, featuring solid stone and exposed brick architecture. The spacious common areas and flower-filled courtyard are designed for sharing moments of authentic conviviality, from the first light of breakfast to a glass of wine at sunset.
house.quote: An architecture that breathes together with the surrounding vineyards, designed to slow down time.

aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.description: My family and I warmly welcome you to our historic retreat in the heart of Monferrato, offering an authentic experience immersed among the rolling hills, where history, nature and culture blend harmoniously.

montemagno.subtitle: The almond-shaped village
montemagno.title: Montemagno
montemagno.description: Perched on the hill, Montemagno is a unique medieval village, famous for its distinctive almond-shaped urban layout and its twelve historic alleys. Walking through its streets means stepping back in time, admiring the imposing crenellated castle that silently dominates the surrounding valley.

monferrato.subtitle: UNESCO World Heritage
monferrato.title: Il Monferrato
monferrato.description: An endless expanse of hills combed by vineyards. Monferrato is a generous land that offers unique gastronomic and wine excellences and villages rich in history. An authentic landscape to get lost in, where colours change with the seasons and offer unforgettable sunsets.

breakfast.subtitle: Morning tastes authentic here
breakfast.title: Garden Breakfast
breakfast.description: Start your day immersed in the greenery of our park, where the scent of coffee blends with the fresh morning air. Our breakfast celebrates the territory with a careful selection of homemade cakes and tarts, artisan bread, fresh seasonal fruit and local zero-kilometre delights, designed to give you a sweet and rejuvenating awakening.

items.name: Franco Bocca
items.text: A truly delightful stay in a setting surrounded by greenery, cared for in every detail and with a breathtaking view. Impeccably clean. The warm welcome, kindness and helpfulness of the owners are an added value that makes the experience unforgettable. We'll definitely be back!

items.name: Samantha Gallo
items.text: We spent 2 nights in this wonderful place and immediately felt at home. Spotlessly clean and Mrs Margherita was so kind! I recommend everyone to try this beautiful experience — we'll be back!

items.name: Manuela Testa
items.text: We stayed just one night at B&B Il Respiro del Borgo but we felt at home right away. The room is spacious, clean and on the ground floor. Stunning view over the hills and the castle of Montemagno.

items.name: Ilaria Guazzo
items.text: Our stay with Margherita was very pleasant. The room was spotless and the breakfast delicious. Margherita was so kind and always available. Highly recommended!

items.name: Maura Ferrari
items.text: A welcoming and clean place. The room is spacious and overlooks a beautiful garden. A location with a breathtaking view over the hills and the castle of Montemagno, in the heart of the Monferrato.

items.name: Liliana Aiulfi
items.text: A truly enchanting place with wonderful hosts! We felt at home. I recommend it 100%. We'll be back… promise!!

hero.subtitle: Spaces and atmospheres
hero.title: The House
hero.tagline: A brick farmhouse where time slows down

intro.title: A house that tells the story of Monferrato
intro.body: Il Respiro del Borgo was born from the careful restoration of an old Piedmontese farmhouse, where every stone, every beam and every exposed brick holds the memory of rural life. We restored the rooms with respect, preserving the original soul of the "grandmother's house" and enriching it with discreet modern comfort. The result is an intimate, warm and bright home, designed to make you feel at home from your very first step.
intro.quote: Here the walls breathe together with the vineyards: we simply reopened the windows onto time.

house.subtitle: Outdoor living, unhurried days
house.title: The Outdoor Spaces
house.description: Here, the best moments happen outdoors. The panoramic veranda is our bright living room: wrapped in large windows that frame the vineyards, it welcomes slow mornings over coffee and long, unhurried afternoons in the light. Just beyond, the garden opens onto the rolling hills — a peaceful corner to breathe deeply, read in the shade and let time stretch out. Two spaces shaped by greenery, natural light and quiet care, designed for guests who come to the Monferrato in search of calm, nature and a genuine sense of wellbeing.

room.subtitle: Your private retreat
room.title: The Room
room.description: The room is a quiet, intimate nest, furnished with authentic pieces of rural tradition and finishes cared for down to the smallest detail. It can be arranged to host a couple in a double bed or two guests in single beds, dressed in natural linen and cotton for a deep, restful sleep; the windows open onto the hills and let in the first light of morning. The bright en-suite bathroom is finished in period tiles, and a private entrance ensures freedom and tranquillity, in a space designed for two.

cta.title: Come and experience it yourself
cta.body: Our room is ready to welcome you. Write to us to check availability and treat yourself to a few days of authentic breathing space in Monferrato.

hero.subtitle: The territory
hero.title: The Surroundings
hero.tagline: Among the UNESCO World Heritage hills of Monferrato

intro.title: In the heart of the Monferrato hills
intro.body: Il Respiro del Borgo lies in Montemagno, a small medieval village set among the vineyards of the Asti Monferrato, recognised as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. This is a land of gentle hills, historic cellars and generous tables, where every season paints the landscape in different colours. From here begin walks, wine roads and art itineraries that reveal an authentic Piedmont, still pleasantly uncrowded.
intro.quote: A landscape that changes colour with every hour, and never stops surprising you.

montemagno.subtitle: The almond-shaped village
montemagno.title: Montemagno
montemagno.description: Perched on the hill, Montemagno is a unique village, famous for its distinctive almond-shaped urban layout and its twelve historic alleys. A monumental staircase leads up to the parish church and the imposing castle that dominates the valley. Walking through these streets means stepping back in time, among quiet glimpses and panoramas that open onto the vineyards. The house sits right in the village, just a few steps from everything.

monferrato.subtitle: UNESCO World Heritage
monferrato.title: Il Monferrato
monferrato.description: An endless expanse of hills combed by vineyards, Monferrato is a generous land that offers gastronomic and wine excellences known the world over: from Barbera to Grignolino, from truffles to farmhouse cheeses. Between one village and the next you'll find welcoming cellars, Romanesque churches and the "Infernot", small cellars carved into the local sandstone, also a UNESCO heritage. A territory to be enjoyed slowly, glass after glass.

wine.title: Cellars & wine
wine.text: Visits and tastings in family-run wineries, between Barbera, Grignolino and Ruché. We'll point you to the producers we love most.

walks.title: Walks & cycling
walks.text: Trails through the vineyards and white gravel roads, perfect for walks, e-bikes and sunset rides from one hill to the next.

food.title: Local flavours
food.text: Trattorias and farm restaurants serving agnolotti, bagna càuda and Monferrato truffles, paired with local wines.

culture.title: Art & castles
culture.text: Castles, Romanesque churches and medieval villages just minutes away by car, for lovers of history, art and photogenic views.

cta.title: Let us guide you through the hills
cta.body: When you arrive, we'll be glad to suggest itineraries, cellars and tables tailored to you. Write to us and let's start imagining your stay together.

That's why we've thought of everything that can make your stay comfortable and serene, leaving you free to enjoy the silence of the hills. privacy.intro: This site collects as little data as possible, and none of it for advertising or statistics. Below is the full account of what happens to your data when you write to us: who receives it, where it goes, how long it stays and what you can ask us at any time.

controller.title: Who processes your data
controller.body: The data controller is Il Respiro del Borgo, the guest house that runs this site and receives the enquiries sent through the contact form.
controller.noDpo: Given the size of the property, no Data Protection Officer has been appointed: for anything concerning your data, write directly to the address above.

data.title: What we collect
data.body: Only what you type into the contact form, plus the few technical details needed to keep it working safely. We never ask you to register and there is no account.

identity.label: First name, last name, email
identity.text: required: without them we cannot reply to you.

stay.label: Phone, dates, number of guests
stay.text: optional: we only ask so we can answer more precisely about availability.

message.label: Your message
message.text: whatever you choose to write. Please don't include anything the enquiry doesn't need.

technical.label: Technical data
technical.text: the language you are browsing in, the page you sent the enquiry from, your browser, and an encrypted, non-reversible version of your IP address. The IP address itself is never stored.

data.noSpecialCategories: We do not process special categories of data (health, beliefs, orientation) and we ask you not to put them in your message. If your stay involves specific needs, we would rather discuss them by phone or in person.

purposes.title: Why we process it

items.reply: To reply to you and arrange a possible stay. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR, pre-contractual measures taken at your request. That is why we do not ask for your consent: without this data your enquiry cannot be handled at all.
items.abuse: To protect the form from automated submissions and abuse, using the encrypted version of your IP address. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, our legitimate interest in keeping the site working.
items.consent: To record the choice you make on the cookie banner, so we can show when and to what you consented. Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR, the legal obligation to keep proof of consent.

purposes.noObligation: We do not use your data for marketing, we do not add you to any mailing list, and we make no automated decisions and carry out no profiling.

storage.title: Where it goes
storage.body: Your enquiry is emailed to the property's mailbox and, at the same time, saved in a database. The database exists so that no enquiry is lost: if the email fails to send, your enquiry is still recorded and we can recover it. Previously there was only the email, and a failed delivery meant an enquiry gone for good.
storage.location: Data is held on servers located in the European Union, encrypted both in transit and at rest. Access is limited to the people who run the property.

recipients.title: Who else sees it
recipients.body: Nobody outside the property. We do rely on a few technical suppliers, which process the data on our behalf as processors:

hosting.label: Vercel
hosting.text: hosts the site and keeps its technical logs.

email.label: Google (Gmail)
email.text: delivers and stores the enquiry emails in the property's mailbox.

database.label: Supabase
database.text: hosts the database where enquiries are recorded.

maps.label: Google Maps
maps.text: shows the map of the property, and only if you choose to load it. Until you do, Google receives nothing from this site.

recipients.noSale: Your data is never sold, rented or traded with anyone. It may be disclosed to the authorities only where the law requires it.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: Enquiries stay in the database for {months} months from the day you send them.
retention.anonymisation: After that they are not deleted but automatically anonymised: first name, last name, email, phone, message and the encrypted IP are irreversibly cleared. What remains cannot be traced back to anyone — the dates requested, the number of guests, the language and the month of the enquiry — and helps us understand how the season is going. From that moment it is no longer personal data, and there is nothing left about you to erase.
retention.mailbox: The email itself stays in the property's mailbox for as long as needed to handle your enquiry and any resulting stay. If a stay does go ahead, the tax records it produces are kept for ten years, as Italian law requires.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: At any time you can ask us:

items.access: to access the data concerning you and receive a copy of what we hold;
items.rectification: to correct anything wrong or incomplete;
items.restriction: to restrict how it is processed;
items.portability: to receive it in a machine-readable format;
items.objection: to object to processing based on our legitimate interest.

rights.how: Just write to {email}. We reply within a month; if the request is complex it may take up to three, and we will tell you. There is no charge for any of this.
rights.complaint: If you think something is wrong, you have the right to complain to the Italian Data Protection Authority (www.garanteprivacy.it) or to the supervisory authority of the country where you live.

security.title: Security
security.body: The site is served only over an encrypted connection (HTTPS). The database is encrypted, reachable only with private credentials, and not publicly accessible. Your IP address is never stored as it is: it is transformed with a one-way function and a secret key held separately, and the original address cannot be recovered from the result.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: This site uses technical cookies only, plus the Google map, which loads only after you explicitly allow it. The complete list is in the

changes.title: Changes to this notice
changes.body: If we change anything we update the date at the top of this page. If the change concerns third-party services or the purposes of processing, the cookie banner will be shown again so you can choose afresh.

analytics.title: Site usage statistics
analytics.body: We measure how the site is used — how many pages are read, which ones, for how long, from which country — because it is the only way to tell what works and what does not. We do it without knowing who you are, and without being able to find out later.

items.what: We collect: the page visited, the language, how long you stay on it, your screen size (in three bands), the site you arrived from if any, and a few interactions such as sending the form or loading the map.
items.noStorage: We store nothing on your device: no cookie, no browser data. That is why these statistics are not something the banner asks you about.
items.visitor: To tell two visitors apart within the same day we use a code computed from your IP address and browser, mixed with a secret number generated at random each day and then destroyed. Once that number is deleted the code cannot be linked back to anyone — including by us.
items.country: The country is reported to us by the provider hosting the site. Your IP address is never stored.

analytics.basis: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, our legitimate interest in understanding how the site is used. The impact on you is minimal by construction: the data is about pages rather than people, and after thirty days even the code that distinguishes one visitor from another is cleared, leaving only aggregate figures.

cookiePolicy.intro: This site uses no profiling cookies, has no analytics and carries no advertising. What follows is the complete list, with nothing left out, of what gets stored on your device.

what.title: What they are
what.body: Cookies are small files a site saves in your browser to remember something between one page and the next. Local storage works the same way, except the value stays on your device and is not sent along with requests.
what.categories: Technical cookies make the site work and need no consent from you. Everything else — analytics, advertising, third-party content — needs consent up front, and on this site the only such case is the map.

technical.title: Technical cookies
technical.body: Always on, because without them the site would not do what you ask of it. They do not identify you as a person and are not shared with anyone.

locale.purpose: Remembers the language you chose, so you don't have to pick it again on every visit.

localeStorage.purpose: The same language preference, kept in the browser's local storage.
localeStorage.duration: Until you clear your browser data

consent.purpose: Remembers the choice you made on the cookie banner, so it isn't shown again on every page.

technical.serverNote: One clarification, because an earlier version of this page said otherwise: the language cookie is sent to our server with every request — that is how the site knows which language to answer in. It is still technical data, it does not identify you, and it goes nowhere else.

thirdParty.title: Third party: the map
thirdParty.body: The map of the property is a Google Maps frame. When you load it, Google receives your IP address and information about your browser, and may store its own cookies on your device under its own privacy policy — over which we have no control.

maps.purpose: Cookies set by Google for security, preferences and — depending on your history with Google services — profiling.
maps.duration: From 6 months to 2 years, decided by Google

thirdParty.gate: That is why the map does not load by itself: in its place you get a panel with a button, and until you press it no request goes to Google at all. If you would rather not load it, you can still open the property's location directly on Google Maps in a new tab.

absent.title: What isn't here
absent.body: Worth listing, because it is everything you would expect to find and won't:

items.analytics: no third-party analytics: no Google Analytics, no equivalents. The little we measure stays on our own servers, without cookies (see above).
items.advertising: no advertising cookies, no tracking pixels, no remarketing.
items.social: no social network buttons or embedded content.
items.fonts: the typefaces are downloaded from Google at build time and served from our own site: your browser never contacts Google's servers to load them.

manage.title: Changing your mind
manage.body: Your choice is not final, and withdrawing it is as easy as giving it.
manage.browser: Alternatively you can delete this site's cookies from your browser settings: you will simply be asked again on your next visit.
manage.consequence: Refusing or withdrawing consent limits nothing about using the site: the only difference is that instead of the interactive map you will see a panel with a link to open it on Google Maps.

more.title: The rest of your data
more.body: What happens to the data you type into the contact form is explained in the

analytics.title: Statistics: no cookies
analytics.body: The site measures its own usage, but it does so with no cookies and without writing anything to your device.

items.noCookie: no cookie, no local storage, no identifier that outlives your visit;
items.rotating: visitors are told apart using a code computed with a random secret that changes every day and is then destroyed: from one day to the next, nobody can be recognised;
items.firstParty: the data stays ours and in our own database — no third-party company receives it.

analytics.why: Precisely because nothing is stored on your device and no individual can be identified, these statistics need no consent from you under the Italian Data Protection Authority's guidelines. It is also why you will not find Google Analytics here.

terms.intro: These terms govern the use of this site. They are few and to the point: the site describes the property and lets you write to us, and nothing more. In particular, the contact form starts a conversation — it is not a booking.

scope.title: Purpose
scope.body: This site is informational and a way to get in touch: it presents the property, its spaces, its services and the area around it, and offers a form for asking about availability. It is not a booking platform and it handles no payments.
scope.owner: The site is run by Il Respiro del Borgo, {address}, CIN {cin}.

notABooking.title: An enquiry is not a booking
notABooking.body: This is the most important point on the page. When you send the form you are asking for information: you are not booking and you are not holding any dates.

items.noCommitment: sending it commits neither you nor us, and creates no contract;
items.noPayment: you are never asked for payment, on the site or as a condition of getting a reply;
items.confirmation: a stay is confirmed only when we explicitly confirm it to you in writing, with dates, price and conditions.

notABooking.terms: The terms of the stay — price, deposit, arrival and departure times, cancellation — are given to you at that point, and become binding only with the confirmation. Until then, any availability shown or discussed is always indicative.

use.title: Using the site
use.body: We ask for little, but we do ask:

items.accurate: give real details: a wrong email address simply means you will get no reply;
items.lawful: do not use the form to send offensive, unlawful or promotional content;
items.automated: do not use automated systems to send bulk enquiries or to harvest the site's content. The form has technical limits designed for exactly that.

content.title: Site content
content.body: Text, photographs and descriptions portray the property as faithfully as we can manage, but they remain descriptive material: small differences from what you will find are possible, and the shared spaces and garden change with the seasons.
content.prices: Any prices or availability shown on the site are indicative and do not constitute an offer. Only what we confirm to you in writing counts.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.body: The photographs, text, name and mark of the property belong to Il Respiro del Borgo. You are welcome to share pages of the site; reusing photographs or text in other contexts requires our written permission.

availability.title: Availability of the site
availability.body: We do what we can to keep the site reachable, but we cannot promise it will never be interrupted: maintenance, updates or problems at our technical suppliers can take it offline temporarily. If you are in a hurry, the phone and WhatsApp always work.
availability.links: The site links to external services (Google Maps, WhatsApp). We do not control those services and are not responsible for their content or their terms.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: We are not liable for damage arising from improper use of the site, from temporary unavailability, or from information that, despite being entered with care, turns out to be inaccurate or out of date.
liability.consumer: Nothing in these terms limits the rights the law gives you as a consumer, nor our liability in cases where the law does not permit exclusions.
